sections.description: ST House Keeping is a clean, modern, and professionally designed WordPress theme created specifically for housekeeping, Cleaning Services, Maid Agencies, Home Maintenance Providers, Janitorial Companies, Labor Services, House Cleaning, Apartment Cleaners, Industrial Cleaning, Office Cleaning, Housemaid Solutions, Painting Services, Construction Services, Handyman Services, Plumbing Services, Washing Services, Babysitting Services, Cleaning Products, Cleaning Equipment, Dry Cleaning Services, Car Washing Services and related businesses. The theme is built on a fully responsive, mobile-first layout that stays sharp on desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones, so every visitor gets the same polished experience whatever screen they use. Setup is handled entirely through the WordPress Customizer and the block editor: upload a custom logo, set a custom header image and background color, pick your own page loader image and loader background, and build pages with wide and full-width blocks, block styles, and responsive embeds, all without writing a single line of code. Multiple widget areas across the sidebar and footer make it easy to place contact details, business hours, service lists, opening times, social links, and call-to-action content exactly where you want them, while the custom menus, featured images, sticky posts, and threaded comments keep your blog and service updates well organised. Built-in WooCommerce support with product gallery zoom, lightbox, and slider lets you sell cleaning products, equipment, or bookable service packages straight from your website. ST House Keeping follows WordPress coding standards with clean, SEO-friendly HTML5 markup, self-hosted Font Awesome icons, accessible skip links, and keyboard-friendly navigation, all optimised for fast page loading and better search engine visibility. Whether you are launching a brand-new cleaning business website or refreshing an existing one, ST House Keeping gives housekeeping, maid, janitorial, handyman, and home service providers a professional and reliable online presence.
